findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color preference
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light screenshot, and the CSS probe found no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: A perpetual header animation continues under reduced-motion
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, getAnimations() still reported a running 10-second infinite gradient animation; CSS has no reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the non-essential animated gradient in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not provide directional continuity
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS contains no view-transition rules; the MPA navigation and form replacement rely on abrupt state swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions and a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The long page offers no scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: The mobile layout is 7,987px tall, but the CSS probe found no scroll timeline/state behavior or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight progress or scroll-state cue for the long instructional page.

findings.summary: Navigation and replaced form state do not guide attention
findings.evidence: The state probe found no view-transition/highlight/scroll-marker treatment; the valid submission replaced the main content without a visible result or focused status.
findings.suggestedFix: Move focus to an announced result region and use restrained directional state transitions.

findings.summary: Consent can obscure the requested content on entry
findings.evidence: A fresh contact-page session placed focus in a full consent dialog before the form, covering the core content and presenting Consent and Manage options only.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent surface with equally direct accept/reject controls.
findings.guidanceId: avoid intrusive interstitial popup content first

findings.summary: Overlays use custom modal markup instead of native dialog primitives
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found zero dialog/popover elements while the page ships custom .modal markup and a third-party consent dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> or popover for owned overlays, with native focus and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is only viewport-level
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container queries despite reusable header, form, and content components across templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container query boundaries where shared components need local size adaptation.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and control sizing are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus on the primary URL field produced outline: none; the platform probe also found four interactive targets below 24px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styling and enlarge small interactive targets.

findings.summary: A representative valid TikTok URL dead-ends without a result
findings.evidence: After submitting a representative public TikTok URL and waiting 8 seconds, the result contained no download links and no explanatory error, while the page body collapsed to header/footer content.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an explicit success result or a visible actionable failure with retry guidance; never leave the main task blank.

findings.summary: The primary flow has an unannounced blank failure state
findings.evidence: Invalid input produced clear text, but a representative valid-looking URL produced an empty error node and no recovery message or status announcement.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an aria-live status region for loading, success, and errors, preserve the form, and expose retry/cancel controls.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is well outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 8.6s, Speed Index 5.8s, TBT 120ms, and performance 0.69; the unthrottled trace’s LCP was 1.17s, confirming network/device conditions drive the regression.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the real LCP resource, reserve ad space, and defer non-critical third-party work.

findings.summary: The LCP resource is discovered late and critical hints are ineffective
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported the ad image was not discoverable in initial HTML and lacked fetchpriority; the longest request chain was 1.33s with unused preconnect warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the intended LCP element discoverable in initial HTML, prioritize it, and remove or correct unused preconnects.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts dominate transferred and unused JavaScript
findings.evidence: HAR measured 605KB of script across seven requests; Lighthouse estimated 268KiB unused JS, led by AdSense and two Google tag bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Load advertising/analytics only after consent and when slots are near use; consolidate tags and remove unused vendors.

findings.summary: Primary and contact form controls lack programmatic labels
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the label audit for the hidden hamburger checkbox; DOM probes found no label for the required URL input and no labels for contact email/message fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate visible labels with every input and give the menu toggle an accessible name without hiding its label.

findings.summary: Focus feedback and post-action focus management are weak
findings.evidence: The primary URL field has no outline when focused, and the valid submission did not move focus to a named result/status region.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply visible :focus-visible styles and move focus predictably to announced results/errors.

findings.summary: Several controls fall below robust target sizing
findings.evidence: The platform probe found four interactive targets below 24px in one dimension, although the page reflowed without horizontal overflow and permits 5x scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase compact controls to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: Several images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The image audit found three of 12 images missing width or height, seven without responsive sources, and four SVGs rendered far below intrinsic width.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide width and height for every image and appropriate responsive source strategy for raster content.

findings.summary: Browser inspector issues are generated by advertising cookies
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices scored 0.77 and reported a Cookie inspector issue plus a third-party cookie from DoubleClick.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove obsolete third-party cookie dependencies and verify a clean DevTools Issues panel.

findings.summary: Structured metadata makes unsupported rating claims
findings.evidence: The homepage JSON-LD declares a 4.9 aggregateRating with 297,531 reviews while no rating or review evidence appears in the rendered page; og:type is article for an app utility.
findings.suggestedFix: Only publish structured claims visible and verifiable on-page; use a fitting WebApplication/website social type.
findings.guidanceId: structured data schema.org json-ld open graph social preview metadata

findings.summary: Cookies and CSP do not meet the secure baseline
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff, but no CSP; all four observed first-party cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing CSP and mark HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest practical SameSite value.

findings.summary: The page sends data to a broad advertising and analytics surface
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 10 third-party origins and five known tracker domains; the consent copy states data may be shared with 210 partners.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendors, gate all non-essential requests on consent, and document a minimal data purpose and retention policy.

findings.summary: Key browser-enforced policy headers are absent
findings.evidence: The header audit found no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy in addition to the missing CSP; clickjacking protection and HSTS were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strict Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy and express frame protection in CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: The app-like site advertises a manifest but is not installable or offline-capable
findings.evidence: The manifest has empty name and short_name and no start_url; navigator.serviceWorker.ready did not resolve during the test.
findings.suggestedFix: Complete the manifest and add a service worker with a useful offline fallback, or stop presenting the surface as installable.
findings.guidanceId: offline fallback service worker web app manifest installable pwa

findings.summary: Consent prioritizes acceptance over refusal
findings.evidence: The consent dialog says data may be shared with 210 partners and exposes Consent plus Manage options, but no equally prominent reject action on the first layer.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide reject-all beside accept-all, keep choices neutral, and make withdrawal easy.

findings.summary: Errors are visible but not exposed as accessible status
findings.evidence: Invalid URL text is clear, but #errorContainer has no alert/live semantics; the contact form fields are not required and empty submission was intercepted by consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction and announce errors in a persistent aria-live/role=alert region linked to the field.

findings.summary: Forms omit labels and autofill assistance
findings.evidence: The URL, contact email, and message controls have empty autocomplete values; contact email is type=text and fields have no associated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type=email, visible labels, and appropriate autocomplete tokens such as email.

findings.summary: The dynamically selected LCP ad image is not responsively delivered
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identified a 360x300 ad image inserted after parse as LCP without initial discovery; the image audit also found missing dimensions and responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve correctly sized modern image variants with intrinsic dimensions and avoid making a late ad the LCP.

findings.summary: Advertising and analytics ship substantial work before user value
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 29 requests and 646KB transferred, including 605KB script; Lighthouse found 268KiB unused JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential analytics and ads until consent and proximity to use; remove redundant tags.

findings.summary: Third-party tracking consumes a disproportionate page budget
findings.evidence: Ten third-party origins and five known tracker domains support a simple URL form; scripts account for nearly all transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget and retain only vendors with measured user value.

findings.summary: The downloader capability is not exposed as a structured agent action
findings.evidence: The site is fully visible to non-JS crawlers, but the DOM probe found only a conventional form and no WebMCP or agentic-tool registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose the URL download action with clear field semantics and an optional safe agentic form/tool contract.

taskList.title: Make the primary download flow always return an announced success or actionable failure state
Gate and sharply reduce advertising/analytics vendors and unused script
Secure cookies and deploy CSP, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy
Fix labels, focus visibility, touch targets, and form autocomplete
Remove the blocking consent pattern and provide equal reject/accept choices
Improve mobile LCP and responsive image delivery
Respect dark mode and reduced motion preferences
